digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions CI macOS test infrastructure
propositions: macOS pytest jobs are I/O-bound on many small Git repository writes, with cProfile showing 13.69s spent in git-add/git-commit pairs during the import benchmark long pole.

A measured ephemeral APFS RAM disk sized with 50% headroom and below 40% physical memory is proposed to accelerate Git-heavy test trees, following precedent in apple-oss-distributions/Git CI and aeron-io/aeron.

Experimental implementation with cleanup repair for intentionally read-only snapshot fixture permissions showed no consistent macOS wall-time improvement over control (treatment runs 5-7.5% slower) and failed to exceed the 5%-or-variation threshold for retention.
The experiment must be reverted per AC7: no RAM-disk implementation is retained unless it clears the predeclared improvement threshold and the full matrix remains green.
